title: Collatz steps
hints: You don't know in advance how many steps there will be, so a condition-only loop (for n != 1 { … }) fits better than a counting loop.
Inside the loop, use if n%2 == 0 to choose between the two rules, and increment a step counter once per transformation.
Handle n <= 0 first (return -1). Then steps := 0; for n != 1 { if n%2 == 0 { n /= 2 } else { n = 3*n + 1 }; steps++ }; return steps.
